definitions.explanation: The contamination of water bodies such as rivers, lakes, oceans, and groundwater by harmful substances.

examples.japanese: {水質汚染|すいしつおせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: Water pollution has become a problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{排水|はいすい}→排水：11104_haisui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{水質汚染|すいしつおせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧だ。
examples.english: Factory wastewater is the cause of water pollution.

examples.japanese: {水質汚染|すいしつおせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are strict regulations to prevent water pollution.

notes:
{水質汚染|すいしつおせん} refers to the degradation of water quality due to pollutants. Common sources include industrial waste, agricultural runoff, and sewage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水質汚染|すいしつおせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧ (to prevent water pollution)
- {水質汚染|すいしつおせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧ (cause of water pollution)
- {水質汚染|すいしつおせん}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (water pollution countermeasures)
